title: Nonex Clientside Immersion
description: A clientside modpack you can use on all servers with immersive mods
body:
# 🌿 Nonex: Clientside Immersion

Step into a whole new level of **immersion** without compromising on **performance**!  
This carefully curated modpack is built for players who want their **vanilla survival** to feel deeper, more atmospheric, and visually stunning — all while keeping performance smooth and optimized.

Whether you're exploring, building, or optimizing your farms, there's something here for everyone. From **visual enhancements** and **audio immersion** to powerful technical tools like _Litematica_, _Tweakaroo_, and many more — it's all here in one lightweight clientside pack.

---

## 🎮 Perfect for Vanilla Survival Adventures

Experience your world like never before — more alive, more beautiful, and more immersive.

---

## 🔧 Creator's Recommendation

For an even richer soundscape, I highly recommend pairing this pack with the **Cottage Quest Soundpack** for the _Reactive Music_ mod.

**🎧 Download here:**  
[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ErhORi02Ypn3xoniOwYm1OQSWFqN5WLt/view?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ErhORi02Ypn3xoniOwYm1OQSWFqN5WLt/view?usp=sharing)

For better visuals, I recommend using the **Physics Mod**. I can't include it in the pack directly because of licensing issues, but it's downloadable for **free**!

---

## 🎨 Recommended Resource Packs
Here are the packs I actively use with this modpack.
To get the best visuals and consistency, load them in the following order:

1. **Skaar's 3D Totems**  
2. **Simple Grass Flowers**  
3. **Fancy Crops**  
4. **Vervada's Enhanced Plants**  
5. **Vanilla Experience+**

---

Enjoy the pack and feel free to share your experience or suggestions! 😊
